title: UN Commission finds indications of Hamas military use of a hospital
actors: Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups
summary: The Commission considered claims concerning use of Gaza hospitals by Palestinian armed groups.
claim: The Commission found indications that Hamas military wings used a hospital for military purposes, but stated that it could not verify broader claims about command-and-control centres in hospitals.
legal_characterization: Finding of a United Nations commission of inquiry; not a court judgment.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the cited paragraphs and attributed only to the Commission. Qualified language is preserved where the Commission could not verify broader claims.
